text:
alyssa: Quick sync — did the APAC H100 perf sweep finish? I need final numbers to lock Dedicated pool counts for Q3.
raj: yep finished. summary: H100 (ap-southeast) median throughput 420 t/s @ concurrency=16, p99=65ms. A100 (ap-southeast) median 310 t/s @16, p99=95ms. baseline tests without prefix cache.
maria: fwiw we ran q4f16 on both. q4f16 -> +12% throughput, -8% median latency on H100, but we saw a ~2.5% regen perf regression on long-form prompts (>=1024 tokens).
jordan: can you paste the raw numbers? need them for the capacity model.
raj: pasted CSV from the sweep:
```
region,gpu,model,conc,median_tps,p99_ms,quant
ap-southeast,h100,redwood-65b,16,420,65,fp16
ap-southeast,h100,redwood-65b,16,470,60,q4f16
ap-southeast,a100,redwood-65b,16,310,95,fp16
ap-southeast,a100,redwood-65b,16,345,88,q4f16
```
alyssa: thanks. so for dedicated capacity math: if target steady QPS is 32k tokens/sec for that pool, with average request 512 tokens -> ~62 req/s target. using H100 median 420 t/s at conc16 -> roughly 420 tokens/sec per GPU? (we're mixing t/s and reqs though)
maria: small clarification: t/s in the sweep is tokens/sec per GPU under sustained stream. convert: 420 tokens/sec -> ~0.82 requests/sec for 512-token avg. so you'd need ~76 GPUs for steady 62 req/s if you only use fp16 H100 (62/0.82 = 76). with q4f16 that's 470 -> 0.92 r/s -> ~68 GPUs.
ops-sre: that math ignores headroom and burst. we recommend 30% baseline headroom for autoscale triggers + 20% runway for scheduling delays.
jordan: sims from the burst model: 30% headroom -> bump from 68 -> ~88 GPUs (for q4f16). 20% runway on top -> 106 GPUs. ops cost delta is material.
ops-sre: cost estimate: h100 list ~USD X/hr (redacted) => monthly delta ~ +$Yk for that extra runway. we should weigh against routing to cross-region fallback.
raj: cross-region fallback works but increases latency for APAC users when routed to eu-west. p99 jumps ~70ms additional which may violate some SLOs.
alyssa: proposal: reserve a smaller committed pool (canary + steady) sized for q4f16 without runway (68 GPUs), enable autoscale to add ephemeral GPUs up to 30% during predictable evening surge, and set a hard fallback to eu-west only for extreme >2x bursts. canary rollout over 2 weeks.
maria: also recommend toggling regen-sensitive jobs to run on fp16 A100 for now (slightly lower throughput but no regen delta) while we run targeted evals on q4f16 to root-cause the 2.5% regression.
infra-bot: perf-sweep report uploaded: https://internal.redwood/perf/reports/2398765432 — contains raw traces, kernel timelines (flash_attn v2 vs fallback), and KV cache hit-rate heatmaps.
raj: kernel note — H100 run used flash_attn v2 + custom fused rotary kernel. A100 fell back to cuBLAS matmul for some layers leading to higher latency tail.
ops-sre: action items: (1) cost calc for committed vs committed+ephemeral (ops) (2) canary plan doc with rollback time (alyssa) (3) run long-form regen eval on q4f16 across 10k prompts (maria). assign and ETA?
alyssa: I'll draft canary plan today, aim to have PR for review by EOD. raj can you produce a short cost delta table by tomorrow? maria start eval and ping when 2k prompts done.
raj: will do, table by 2400 UTC tomorrow.
maria: started eval job, ETA ~18h, will post interim if regressions spike.
jordan: FYI I'm adding a small autoscale policy tweak to avoid oscillation (min 5m cooldown) and will post config in the ops channel once live.
alyssa: great — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
